name: aipod-agent
description: A pydantic-ai agent that fulfils requests by calling tools from a connected aipod MCP server.

skills.name: Ask
skills.description: Answer a free-form request, calling aipod-server tools as needed.
examples: Summarise this and then write a poem about the result.

skills.name: Poem
skills.description: Write a short rhyming poem (delegates to the server's `poet` tool).
examples: Write a poem about autumn rain.

skills.name: Summary
skills.description: Summarise a passage into headline / summary / key points (`summarize` tool).

skills.name: Weather
skills.description: Narrative forecast for a demo city (`weather_report` tool).

dataEgress.note: Prompt content is sent to the configured model provider and to the aipod MCP server. See that server's /contract.json for its own egress (its sampling tools call back to this agent's model).
